name: New Employee Orientation Checklist
description: A day-one orientation program covering the welcome, policies, workplace tour, and introductions.

items.text: Confirm the start time, location, and schedule
Set up the workspace, badge, and welcome kit
Print the agenda and any handouts for the day
Notify the team and prepare them to welcome the hire
Confirm accounts and equipment are ready
items.note: Verify logins work the day before.

items.text: Assign a host to greet and guide the new hire
Greet the new employee warmly on arrival
Offer a drink and help them settle in
Walk through the agenda for the day
Share the company mission, values, and story
Explain how their role fits the bigger picture
Set a friendly, relaxed tone for the day
items.note: First impressions shape how welcome they feel.

items.text: Review working hours, breaks, and attendance
Explain the code of conduct and key policies
Cover health, safety, and emergency procedures
Walk through where to find the employee handbook
Confirm any required policy acknowledgments are signed
items.note: Required policies vary; follow local laws and HR guidance.

items.text: Answer questions about pay, benefits, and time off
Show the new hire their desk or workspace
Point out restrooms, kitchen, and break areas
Walk through emergency exits and meeting points
Locate printers, supplies, and shared equipment
Explain building access, parking, and security
For remote hires, give a virtual tour of tools and spaces
items.note: Adapt the tour to the work setting.

items.text: Introduce the new hire to their manager and team
Connect them with their onboarding buddy
Meet key colleagues and cross-team contacts
Share a team roster with names and roles
Arrange a welcome lunch or coffee
Explain who to ask for different kinds of help
items.note: Knowing the go-to people reduces day-one stress.

items.text: Confirm the new hire can log in and use core tools
Recap what was covered and what comes next
Share the plan for the rest of the first week
Invite any remaining questions
Collect quick feedback on the orientation
End the day on a warm, encouraging note
items.note: Send them home feeling glad they joined.

faq.a: Orientation is the day-one program that formally welcomes a new hire, covering the welcome, key policies, a workplace tour, and introductions. It gives employees the essentials and a strong first impression.
A warm welcome, an overview of the company and team, essential policies and safety, a tour of the workspace, introductions to colleagues, and confirmation that accounts and equipment work.

faq.q: How is orientation different from onboarding?
faq.a: Orientation is the first-day welcome event. Onboarding is the longer program that includes orientation plus training, goal setting, and check-ins over the employee's first weeks and months.

faq.q: How do you make orientation welcoming?
faq.a: Greet the new hire personally, prepare their space ahead of time, keep the schedule clear, mix information with introductions, and leave room for questions. Warmth matters as much as logistics.

faq.q: Can I print this orientation checklist?
faq.a: Yes. Download the printable PDF, prepare the day in advance, and check off each item as orientation unfolds to give every new hire a consistent, welcoming first day.
